about: Chunker v2 (definition boundaries) against v1 (regex) on the code eval set, same session, same frozen input, same model; plus the graph boost on the served fusion mode. CODE-GRAPH P7.

gate.rule: v2 is not worse than v1 when, in both fusion modes (on and off), every _overall metric -- recall@1, recall@5, recall@10 and MRR -- of v2 is at least v1's minus the weight of ONE case (1/n). Per-class numbers are reported, not gated: with 6-8 cases a class, one case moves a class metric by 12-17 points.
